::: {#def-coverage-probability}
#### Coverage probability

The **coverage probability** of an interval $\cintf{X}$ for a parameter $\param$
is $\Prunder{\param}{\param \in \cintf{X}}$,
computed over repeated samples with $\param$ held fixed.
A $100(1-\siglevel)\%$ [confidence interval](#def-confidence-interval)
has coverage probability at least $1 - \siglevel$
for every $\param$.

Source: [@CaseBerg01, Definition 9.1.4].
:::
